validation_domain: 4 independently range-checked C1/C2 originals; 48 ARM application executions at four memory patterns and true/false/exception-stop resize boundaries. Actual pinned CCL initial capacities/deltas 16/64, zero logical count, growth/clear/destructor and allocation failures. 382 owned-map/provider cases at 0,1,15,16,17,63,64,65,129 sorted items; existing map searches, bar lookup, seconds conversion, immutable copies/rvalues/assignments, transactional replacement and cleanup. Existing 378 borrowed-map, 557 map/event/getter and 20 narrow timeinfo ARM regressions pass.
limitations: Portable source port, not ARM32 ABI/layout or original map inheritance recovery. Typed Item fields and owned immutable storage/record encodings are intentional source-port declarations; unencoded original map return declarations remain unresolved.

Native Core resize is intercepted before any Core instruction; true/false are controlled boundary returns, not actual native provider allocation. Exception case stops at boundary; native unwind/cleanup is not executed or claimed. Pinned CCL provider real array failure/cleanup is separately executed.

Default original constructor allocation sizes are observed r1 requests 16/64; actual source-provider capacities/deltas are preferred policy. Source provider uses throwing host new; no claim of native allocator failure equivalence.

Borrowed APIs retain caller lifetime/readability requirements. Sorted finite item lists required for replacement and existing search assumptions; malformed pointers, unsorted records, concurrent mutation and extreme allocations are excluded.

No original map destructor target, hardware, native Core implementation, actual device I/O, system-call passthrough or the eight retained DAW lifecycle/format/factory targets are delivered. Global full Linux/integration/installed-role/compile-once/registry admission remains Root-owned.
compiled_aliasing: Linux C1/C2 pair symbols share compiler-selected entry addresses; originals are four distinct ranges independently hashed and executed. Matching symbol names do not prove ABI/layout.
